title: sword of the yellow wood
summary: A small action RPG in an autumn wood painted in oils: a sword, a three-hit combo, eight bears. Every trunk, leaf, bear and shadow is a brush stroke fixed in the world, so the paint holds still while you move.
medium: small action rpg scene, three.js, brush strokes as instanced quads, webaudio, single file

specs.controls: click, mouse to look, WASD to walk, shift to run, space to jump, click or F to swing (three in a row), right click or E to dodge, M sound
specs.strokes: about 335,000, each one flat quad in one of three paints
specs.post-processing: none: the picture is never filtered
specs.shadows: drawn once on a hidden 2d canvas, then read by every stroke on the ground
specs.bears: eight, one of them old and big, in the clearing
specs.to find: 14 red mushrooms (a heart each) and 20 golden acorns
specs.inspired by: "a walkable oil-painting world" by @rewind02 on X; the wood, the walker and the code are new
specs.sound: made in the page from noise and a few oscillators
